category_read: One read applied across every mega/large-cap EARNINGS entry below, written once rather than pasted ten times: a $2,586 book has no edge in a two-day mega-cap earnings coin flip. That is the opposite of where a small book's edge lives (idiosyncratic, under-covered, structurally-forced). This is a PASS ON THE CATEGORY, stated as a view so it can be graded against outcomes - not an excuse for not looking.
